title: SkillTrace: Traversing a Query-Skill Graph for Composable LLM Agents
title_zh: SkillTrace：遍历 Query-Skill 图以构建可组合 LLM Agent
abstract_en: Large language model agents increasingly solve complex tasks by composing reusable skills from a library. To address this, the key challenge is not merely to retrieve individually relevant skills, but to identify a complete and executable skill composition. In this paper, we argue that this problem can be solved in a graph with three levels: compositional relations among skill queries, similarity between queries and candidates in the skill library, and the dependencies among the selected candidates. We introduce SkillTrace, which organizes the user query into a semantic hierarchy, matches skill queries and candidates, and propagates over the skill dependencies. Experiments on SkillsBench and ALFWorld demonstrate that SkillTrace achieves state-of-the-art performance, reaching a success rate of 53.17% on SkillsBench and 91.43% on ALFWorld. SkillTrace also delivers consistent improvements across different backbone language models, demonstrating the generality and robustness of graph-based skill retrieval.
abstract_zh: 随着大型语言模型 Agent 越来越多地通过组合技能库中的可复用技能来解决复杂任务，核心挑战已不再是检索单个相关技能，而是识别一套完整且可执行的技能组合。本文提出 SkillTrace，将该问题建模为一个三层图结构：技能查询之间的组合关系、用户查询与技能库候选技能之间的相似性，以及被选中候选技能之间的依赖关系。SkillTrace 首先将用户查询组织为语义层级结构，再匹配技能查询与候选技能，并在技能依赖图上进行传播。实验表明，SkillTrace 在 SkillsBench 和 ALFWorld 上取得了当前最优性能，分别达到 53.17% 和 91.43% 的成功率；同时在不同 backbone language models 上均带来稳定提升，说明基于图的技能检索方法具有良好的通用性与鲁棒性。
key_points_zh: 提出 SkillTrace，将复杂任务的技能检索建模为 Query-Skill 图遍历问题，而非独立检索单个相关技能。
方法包含三类关系：技能查询间的组合关系、查询与技能候选的相似性、以及候选技能之间的执行依赖。
SkillTrace 会将用户查询分解为语义层级，并结合技能匹配与依赖传播来生成可执行的技能组合。
在 SkillsBench 和 ALFWorld 上达到 state-of-the-art，成功率分别为 53.17% 和 91.43%。
在不同 backbone language models 上均有稳定增益，体现了图结构技能检索的通用性和鲁棒性。

llm_assessment.comment: SkillTrace addresses reusable skill composition for agents with a graph-based retrieval mechanism, but offers limited runtime governance or learning-loop infrastructure.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: SkillTrace 通过图检索解决智能体可复用技能组合问题，但在运行时治理或学习闭环基础设施方面较有限。
